description: Run Godot 4.7 headless on the project: import, load and instantiate every script and scene, compile every .gdshader, and optionally run the main scene (or `scene`) for `run_frames` frames and return what it printed (put print() calls in the code you test). Returns the errors and warnings as res://file:line, the totals and the printed output; an error result when Godot reports an error or is not installed. `shaders: true` also draws every shader on the GPU (needs a display or xvfb-run), for what only the driver rejects. Scenes and scripts are not changed: Godot updates its cache in .godot/, where the checker script also goes. Sends progress when the client asks for it; cancelling the call stops Godot. Slower than godot_review, so review first. `compare_godot` (a second Godot binary, or `next` for $GODOT_NEXT) runs the same check on a temporary copy and returns only the errors and warnings that differ, e.g. what breaks in a 4.8 beta. To drive input use godot_play; for unit tests godot_test.

compare_godot.description: second Godot binary to diff against, or "next" for $GODOT_NEXT

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

run_frames.description: also run the main scene for this many frames and return its output (default 0; 120 when scene is given)

scene.description: run this scene (a res:// path) instead of the main scene

shaders.description: also draw every shader on the Compatibility renderer, for what only the GPU driver rejects (needs a display or xvfb-run)

name: godot_check
title: Check with real Godot
